email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with mild nausea
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a treating physician at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 70-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their second dose of DemoBasalin (dose: 1 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-21.
Approximately 7 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild nausea.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
S. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
